result.reason: The cohort satisfies the Feature Module Conventions. Structure: `index.ts` is the single entry point re-exporting the entire public API (`pickWinners`, `PickWinnersInput`, `Award`); types live in a dedicated `award-types.ts`; the logic file `pick-winners.ts` is verb-first kebab-case, exports a single `run`, returns `Result` objects instead of throwing, and provides consumer-grade error messages ('minReviews must be a whole number of 0 or more', 'no parlor has X or more reviews yet'). Cohesion: every file (`award-types.ts`, `pick-winners.ts`) is reachable from `index.ts` through its import graph, so there are no orphaned files; all files serve the single capability of computing yearly awards; and the feature name 'awards' describes the capability rather than its implementation.
